generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you in every module from here on. Each assignment you meet asks you to be critical, each source is a chance to weigh rather than simply accept, and the two together are how your work improves across the degree. The habit to keep is simple: question what you read, weigh the evidence, and reach a judgement you can give reasons for.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you must weigh evidence and decide with reasons, the people who do well are the ones who question rather than accept whatever they are told first. The skill you have just built is one you will use long after you graduate.
